currentCard.explanation: У правого лёгкого три доли — верхняя, средняя и нижняя; у левого — две, верхняя и нижняя. Каждая доля включает несколько бронхолёгочных сегментов.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L36 explicitly gives right lung three lobes (superior/middle/inferior), left lung two (superior/inferior). The ordered pair is therefore 3/2, not 2/3, 3/3 or 2/2. «соответственно» makes right then left unambiguous. The alternatives are four plausible count pairs with the same numbers and similar lengths, all answering «Сколько долей…?». No absurd distractor, unit mismatch or grammatical key cue. The ordinary anatomical reading is intended, not surgical removal or unusual anatomical variants.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: У правого лёгкого три доли — верхняя, средняя и нижняя; у левого — две, верхняя и нижняя. Каждая доля включает несколько бронхолёгочных сегментов.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sentence 1 accurately names the correct answer through the full ordered count pair and the named lobes on each side. Sentence 2 accurately states that lobes contain multiple bronchopulmonary segments. Both facts are explicit at L36; the explanation has two complete sentences and does not conflate lobe, segment and lobule (the latter is distinguished at L37).

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В каждой доле есть несколько бронхолёгочных сегментов; каждый получает воздух от своего третичного бронха и кровь от собственной артерии.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L36 states that each lobe contains multiple bronchopulmonary segments, each supplied with air by its own tertiary bronchus and with blood by its own artery. The note preserves these subdivisions and adds a structural/supply fact beyond the question’s right/left lobe counts. «каждый» refers to segment, not to lobe or bronchus.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: На поверхности левого лёгкого есть сердечная вырезка, оставляющая место сердцу.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L34 places a cardiac notch on the surface of the left lung and says it leaves space for the heart. The note names the actual left-lung object in the reversed count alternative and gives a useful fact about anatomical asymmetry. It does not assert that 2-right/3-left is true. A distractor note may teach an independent fact about its named object; it is not an empty denial or a fact about a different organ. The actual count error is independently evaluated against L36.

absoluteLevel.assessment: The adult reader must know a basic but non-obvious anatomical asymmetry and remember which side has three lobes. Readers familiar with human anatomy can answer; general recognition of lungs or simple arithmetic does not determine the pair. The 2/3 reversal and symmetric alternatives remain credible. This is neither a broad everyday fact guaranteed by adult experience nor a narrow professional detail.
